newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec cuts T-bills, boosts foreign financing.
newsitem.headline: Quebec cuts T-bills, boosts foreign financing.

text.p: Quebec's provincial government announced on Wednesday that it is reducing its weekly issue of 3-month T-bills from C$200 million to C$150 million and cutting the outstanding amount from C$2.7 billion to C$2.05 billion.
Quebec is also reducing its total outstanding T-bills from C$3.8 billion to C$3.15 billion.

These reductions will be offset by a "more efficient use of sources of short-term financing," including a US$500-million increase in commercial paper issued in the United States and a new US$500-million European commercial paper program, Quebec's finance ministry said.
Quebec also revised its total financing program for 1996-97 from C$6.7 billion to C$7.5 billion, the finance ministry said.
